{"body":"Hello Example Venue team,

We request permission to display a clearly labeled, Owner‑approved local offer to authenticated event attendees at your venue via Bowl Vegas. The offer will be shown only to users who authenticate for the event and will be explicitly marked as Owner‑approved.

To protect attendee privacy, Bowl Vegas will not share attendee data with third parties and does not use ad‑network tracking or pixel-based targeting.

We can provide a brief mockup, the exact label wording, and technical details for your review. Please reply with approval or any questions.

Thank you,
Bowl Vegas Partnerships Team","subject":"Request: Approval to Display Owner‑Approved Local Offer to Authenticated Attendees"}
